results.content:
I’ve been trying to register and link my BPI account to Vybe for almost three months now, and the app still returns an error every single time I attempt the process. Despite reinstalling the app, checking for updates, and following all instructions, the issue remains unresolved.I live overseas, and I noticed that many Vybe users—especially those with credit cards—use international mobile numbers. It seems the app doesn’t support this setup properly, which is very limiting and frustrating. We should be able to access services like this regardless of our current location, especially since BPI caters to Filipinos worldwide.Please fix this issue ASAP. Your platform has potential, but this long-standing problem makes it unusable for a significant portion of your user base.
